description:
"Wrap yourself in hardened bone, granting you Major Resolve and Minor Resolve for |cffffff20|r seconds, increasing your Physical Resistance and Spell Resistance by |cffffff5948|r and |cffffff2974|r.

While active, ranged attackers will be pulled to you once every |cffffff2|r seconds and become taunted for |cffffff15|r seconds if they are not already taunted.

If cast during combat, you can cast a corpse consuming ability on yourself. This effect can occur once every |cffffff10|r seconds."
